# Funds holding a company: fund-holder (HELD)

The reverse look-through: every fund of the pack that holds one us-equities company, by value, and the share of the company they own. One row per funds holding a company, keyed by TICKER. Read by the **funds** pack's connector `funds-store` (table `<root>/funds/fund-holder/`). A **snapshot of public data**, captured 2026-10-26 from SEC Form N-PORT, Form N-CEN and risk/return summary data sets, SEC and Nasdaq Trader ticker files, GLEIF (tools/publicdata/funds.py), refreshed whole by its script (External data); 586 records. A refresh replaces the whole snapshot.

## File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `data/testdata/funds/fund-holder/` + `snapshot-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.gz` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line, gzip-compressed (`.jsonl.gz`) |
| Key field | `TICKER` |
| Date field | none in the record: a snapshot of public data, its file named by the capture date; the demo lake serves the same records on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | `TICKER`, `NAME`, `FUNDS`, `TOTAL_VALUE`, `PCT_OF_SHARES` |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | the whole snapshot |

## Field reference

Every field of the record above, nested ones as dotted paths (`[]` marks an array of objects). *Required* is the contract's; *in N%* is how often the test data fills it.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `TICKER` | string | required | The us-equities company's ticker. Source: us-equities us-company.TICKER. | — | `"A"` |
| `NAME` | string | required | The company's name. Source: us-equities us-company.NAME. | — | `"Agilent Technologies"` |
| `COMPANY` | string | required | The company; opens USEQ. Source: us-equities. | links to `us-company` | `"A"` |
| `SECTOR` | string | required | Its SIC division. Source: us-equities us-company.SECTOR. | — | `"Manufacturing"` |
| `FUNDS` | integer | required | How many of the pack's funds hold it. Source: computed from every fund's holdings. | unit: funds | `43` |
| `ETFS` | integer | required | How many of them are ETFs. Source: computed. | unit: funds | `15` |
| `TOTAL_VALUE` | number | required | The value the funds hold together. Source: computed from N-PORT CURRENCY_VALUE. | unit: USD | `7751546198.0` |
| `TOTAL_SHARES` | number | required | The shares the funds hold together. Source: computed from N-PORT BALANCE. | unit: shares | `57800330.0` |
| `SHARES_OUTSTANDING` | integer | optional (filled in 92% of rows) | The company's shares outstanding (10-K cover). Source: us-equities us-company.SHARES_OUTSTANDING (SEC XBRL dei). | unit: shares | `283498871` |
| `PCT_OF_SHARES` | number | optional (filled in 91% of rows) | Shares held over shares outstanding; empty where the filed count cannot be compared. Source: computed. | unit: % | `20.388` |
| `AVG_WEIGHT` | number | required | Its average weight in the funds holding it. Source: computed. | unit: % of net assets | `0.1313` |
| `MAX_WEIGHT` | number | required | Its largest weight in a fund. Source: computed. | unit: % of net assets | `1.4933` |
| `TOP_HOLDER` | string | required | The fund holding the most, by value. Source: computed. | — | `"VTI"` |
| `HOLDERS` | array of objects | required | Every fund holding it, by value (at most 250). Source: computed. | — | [43 objects] |
| `HOLDERS[].FUND` | string | required | The fund's ticker; opens FUND. Source: computed. | links to `fund` | `"VTI"` |
| `HOLDERS[].FUND_NAME` | string | required | The fund's name. Source: N-PORT FUND_REPORTED_INFO.SERIES_NAME. | — | `"Vanguard Total Stock Market Index Fund"` |
| `HOLDERS[].TYPE` | string | required | The fund's type. Source: N-CEN FUND_REPORTED_INFO.IS_ETF, the Nasdaq Trader directory. | one of `ETF`, `Mutual fund`, `Mutual fund with an ETF share class`, `ETF (unit investment trust)` | `"Mutual fund with an ETF share class"` |
| `HOLDERS[].PCT` | number | required | The company's weight in the fund (every line of it added). Source: N-PORT FUND_REPORTED_HOLDING.PERCENTAGE. | unit: % of net assets | `0.0518` |
| `HOLDERS[].VALUE` | number | required | The value the fund holds. Source: N-PORT FUND_REPORTED_HOLDING.CURRENCY_VALUE. | unit: USD | `1190260009.0` |
| `HOLDERS[].SHARES` | number | optional (filled in over 99% of `HOLDERS[]` entries) | The shares the fund holds (balances in shares only). Source: N-PORT FUND_REPORTED_HOLDING.BALANCE. | unit: shares | `8960777.0` |
| `HOLDERS[].REPORT_DATE` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The date the fund's report is as of. Source: N-PORT SUBMISSION.REPORT_DATE. | — | `"2026-06-30"` |

| `TOP_WEIGHTS[].FUND` | string | required | The fund's ticker. Source: computed. | links to `fund` | `"VGHCX"` |
| `TOP_WEIGHTS[].PCT` | number | required | The company's weight in it. Source: computed. | unit: % of net assets | `1.4933` |

## Fields in other rows

None: all 586 rows were read, and every field any of them has is in the record above.

## For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `TICKER` per `snapshot`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `TICKER`, `NAME`, `COMPANY`, `SECTOR`, `FUNDS`, `ETFS`, `TOTAL_VALUE`, `TOTAL_SHARES`, `AVG_WEIGHT`, `MAX_WEIGHT`, `TOP_HOLDER`, `HOLDERS`, `TOP_WEIGHTS`, `PROVENANCE` (the contract's required fields).
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Unique: `TICKER` per snapshot.
